summary:
## Standing operator rules
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.
- Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.
- Adding a covering index on invoices(customer_id, created_at) was tried for the slow report; it doubled write latency on the ingest path. Ruled out.
- The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py` so it does not double-count refunds. Elasticsearch alias-swap and tenacity work is paused until next sprint.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Optimizing the slow invoice report with an `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index; it doubled ingest write latency.

## Recent work
Invoice PDF work now renders negative credit lines, uses locale-aware `format_money`, and introduced page-height helpers. A pagination test for 86 items failed (`3 == 2`); header reservation was corrected, but verification remains pending. Report optimization remains passing: 63 report tests passed, 2 skipped, and tenant 73 profiling fell from 39.1s to 4.46s.
